# TECH360 LLC

> TECH360 LLC designs and builds custom websites, CRM systems, client portals, eCommerce platforms, and business workflow automation for organizations worldwide. Deliverables, HTML previews (where included in the agreed process), payment milestones, and source-code handover after verified full payment are governed by each project's approved Scope of Work.

Contact: info@bdtech360.com
Site: https://bdtech360.com
Markdown content negotiation: Send `Accept: text/markdown` to any public URL for a clean Markdown version.
Agent discovery: https://bdtech360.com/.well-known/api-catalog and https://bdtech360.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json
